title: CAT BOW
description: Exploding cats on arrows! Configurable particles, sounds, and more.
body:
Unleash chaos with the Cat Bow, a fun and configurable Minecraft plugin for Paper/purpur servers! Shoot arrows, and instead of ordinary projectiles, cats fly out… then explode! Customize every aspect with an easy-to-edit config.

Features
1.Exploding Cats: Shoot a bow and spawn a cat that explodes after a configurable delay.

2.Configurable Explosion: Adjust size, strength, and delay of the cat explosion.

3.Pre-Explosion Flash & Hiss: Warning effect with glowing cats and configurable RGB flash color.

4.Particle Trails: Optional trails following cats while flying, with customizable RGB color or disable entirely.

5.Sound Effects: Cats meow on spawn and hiss before exploding. Compatible with Minecraft 1.12 → 1.21.8.

Permissions & Commands:

/givecatbow – Give yourself the Cat Bow (permission: catbow.give)

/catbowreload – Reload the config without restarting the server (permission: catbow.reload)
